name: note/UX-B-18
text: UX-B-18 — drag does what drag looks like it does: dropping a folder child on the ungrouped list removes it from the folder, and dropping it on a sibling reorders inside the folder. Today folder children get no reorder target (PageFolder.tsx:280-297) and the root list filters folder members out (PageList.tsx:298-302), so the engine moves the page and the row stays exactly where it was.
